name: 24955-imagechat-qwen3vl8b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 -- four GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:4.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one in-process vLLM engine on one node.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration (`model_type: qwen3_vl`), bf16: 36-layer decoder (hidden 4096, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads) plus a ViT vision tower.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 2000 requests with a 1200 s safety cap, warmup the first 30% by completion -> ~1400 measured requests.
workload: Real image+text chat, one image and one turn per request: `merve/vqav2-small`, split `validation`, 21435 rows, read through guidellm's `huggingface` deserializer with its default column mapping (`question` -> the text, `image` -> the image). Output length is pinned: `max_tokens: 128`, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, so every request generates exactly 128 tokens.
purpose: An image-and-text chat assistant on an 8-billion-parameter model, answering 64 concurrent single-picture questions across four GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM engine configuration. Everything not listed here is left at the engine's own default.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 8192
